visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young female cheerleader with brown hair styled in a bun with a white bow performs on a stage. She wears a vibrant red cheerleader uniform with gold trim, a white inner layer, and a navy and red patterned scarf. Her facial expression is joyful with a broad smile and squinted eyes. Behind her is a baseball field and a protective mesh net. (2) As the dancer continues her rhythmic routine, she swings her arms wide, occasionally holding a red plastic hand-clapper in her right hand. The camera maintains a medium shot, capturing her energetic torso movements and hip swaying. In the distant background, small figures of players are visible on the green and brown baseball diamond under bright daylight. (3) The performer transitions through various cheering poses, extending her hands and pointing while maintaining high energy. A black advertising board with white text and a red triangular logo is positioned behind her feet on the stage. The natural lighting creates a clear, high-contrast visual environment typical of an outdoor stadium during an event.
